stem.en: A photon scatters off a loosely bound electron. What happens to the photon's wavelength as a result?
stem.et: Footon hajub nõrgalt seotud elektronilt. Mis juhtub selle tagajärjel footoni lainepikkusega?

label.en: It increases, since the photon transfers some of its energy and momentum to the electron
label.et: See suureneb, kuna footon kannab osa oma energiast ja impulsist elektronile üle

label.en: It stays exactly the same, since photons cannot exchange energy with electrons
label.et: See jääb täpselt samaks, kuna footonid ei saa elektronidega energiat vahetada

label.en: It decreases, since the electron transfers energy back into the photon
label.et: See väheneb, kuna elektron kannab energiat tagasi footonisse

label.en: It becomes undefined, since scattering destroys the photon entirely
label.et: See muutub määramatuks, kuna hajumine hävitab footoni täielikult
